abstract: Maintains load-bearing setbacks and structural exclusion zone measurements
system_message:
You are the Structural clearance engineer (SCE). Your business responsibility is maintaining load-bearing setbacks and structural exclusion zone measurements for candidate venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: March 2025·Maintains load-bearing setbacks and structural exclusion zone measurements（ENGZ）
information_points.content:
SCE-ENGZ-YHK：For the March 2025 inspection period, Docklands Riverside Expo Centre registered a structural clearance reserve space of 750 m2 based on the survey of its entire rentable perimeter and core columns covering pillar safety buffers and utility corridors.
SCE-ENGZ-7BR：During the March 2025 inspection period, the structural clearance survey determined that Greenwich Meridian Pavilion reserved a structural clearance reserve space of 600 m2 across the core columns and rentable perimeter.
SCE-ENGZ-ZI5：According to the structural clearance survey for the March 2025 inspection period, Olympia Central Exhibition Hall had a structural clearance reserve space of 750 m2, measured as the total mandatory floor area dedicated to load-bearing pillar safety buffers and utility access corridors across the entire rentable perimeter and core columns.

information_points.title: April 2025·Maintains load-bearing setbacks and structural exclusion zone measurements（ROOF）
information_points.content:
SCE-ROOF-JSN：Based on the April 2025 inspection period clearance survey covering the rentable perimeter and core columns, Olympia Central Exhibition Hall exhibited a structural clearance reserve space of 600 m2 for pillar buffers and utility corridors.
SCE-ROOF-WSD：Under the April 2025 inspection period survey, Docklands Riverside Expo Centre demonstrated a structural clearance reserve space of 750 m2 dedicated to load-bearing pillar safety buffers and utility corridors along the entire perimeter and core columns.
SCE-ROOF-5KO：For the April 2025 inspection period, Greenwich Meridian Pavilion had a structural clearance reserve space of 600 m2 across its entire rentable perimeter and core column exclusion zones.
